text.title: Freelancer Rate Raise Letter Template Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals about the client, the contract and the draft letter to the rule from 01-core-rules.xml that governs the next action.

decision-tree.root-question: Are the current rate, the contract's rate-change notice clause, the client's revenue share and at least one value delta pinned to the source of record?

conclusion.verdict: do not draft; without the contract clause and a value delta the letter will be either unenforceable or a CPI note; gather the inputs first.

branch.question: Is the client classified stay / negotiate / churn with evidence, and is the concentration risk covered?

conclusion.verdict: block the send; classify the client with revenue share, alternatives, feedback and payment behaviour first.

branch.when: churn_class == 'churn' AND revenue_share > 0.30 AND replacement_plan_exists == false

conclusion.verdict: defer the raise; write the replacement-revenue plan with named pipeline before this client receives a letter.

branch.when: churn_class_missing == false AND (churn_class != 'churn' OR revenue_share <= 0.30 OR replacement_plan_exists == true)
branch.question: Does the draft letter pass the content checks?

branch.when: days_to_effective_date < 30 OR days_to_effective_date < contract_notice_days OR raises_in_last_12_months >= 1

conclusion.verdict: move the effective date out to the longest of 30 days, one billing cycle and the contract notice period; hold if a raise already happened this year without a scope change.
rewrite the opening around the value delta from inputs_used; demote inflation to a secondary sentence.
state one number with currency, unit, the current rate and the percentage change.
list every signed SOW, quote and prepaid period and state that each completes at the current rate.
remove the fallback from the letter; record one prepared concession in the artefact for T+7.
strip apology and personal-cost language; cut to under 250 words in the business-notice shape.
schedule the T+7 follow-up with a path per response state before sending; new rate applies only on written acknowledgement.
send the letter; log send date, effective date, follow-up date, churn class and the prepared concession in the artefact.

text.example: Retainer client at 18% of revenue, classified negotiate, value delta = release pipeline ownership since March → effective date 45 days out, one number stated (+12%), two in-flight SOWs protected, no concession in the letter, T+7 follow-up scheduled → run-the-checklist.
